# Support

If you need help with the SmartyNotebooks project, please use one of the following resources:

- [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/SiegeSailor/SmartyNotebooks/issues): Open an issue to report a bug or request a feature
- [README.md](./../README.md): Setup instructions and usage guidelines
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md): Guidelines for contributing to the project, including the development environment setup

> [!Note]
> All interactions in the support channels are subject to our [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
